name: inspect_item
text: A shopper holds a small rectangular product on the right palm, slowly tilts and turns it to inspect it from two angles, then lowers the hand toward the waist. Left arm hangs relaxed, head lowered to watch the object. Keep feet planted.

review.reason: 托物手抬至身前，缓慢改变角度后放下；独立单人动作，不保证手指独立抓握。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
